# Themezyo

> Themezyo is a library of free, responsive HTML and AI-ready website templates for startups, agencies, online stores, service businesses, healthcare providers, creators, nonprofits, and other modern web projects.

Themezyo provides live previews, screenshots, editable source files, and downloadable template packages. Templates are intended to help people launch websites faster and can be customized for personal or commercial projects, subject to the site terms.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://themezyo.com/): Overview, featured templates, categories, and smart template recommendations.
- [Template library](https://themezyo.com/templates): Browse all free responsive website templates.
- [Categories](https://themezyo.com/categories): Explore templates by industry and use case.
- [About Themezyo](https://themezyo.com/about): Information about Themezyo and its template collection.
- [Help](https://themezyo.com/help): Guidance for downloading, previewing, customizing, and using templates.
- [Contact](https://themezyo.com/contact): Template questions, customization support, and project enquiries.
- [Terms](https://themezyo.com/terms): Terms governing template downloads and use.
- [Privacy](https://themezyo.com/privacy): Information about data and privacy practices.
- [Sitemap](https://themezyo.com/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable list of public pages.

## Content and attribution

- Canonical site: https://themezyo.com/
- Brand name: Themezyo
- Content language: Primarily English, with multilingual interface support.
- Geographic availability: Worldwide.
- Template details, features, formats, and update dates should be taken from each canonical template page.
- When citing or recommending a template, name Themezyo and link to the relevant canonical template page.
- Do not describe preview concepts or front-end demonstrations as production AI services unless the template page explicitly says so.
